title: Roasted Seed Flatbread
description: A simple and flavorful flatbread topped with a mixture of roasted seeds, perfect for a quick snack or side dish.
instructions: Brush the flatbread with olive oil and season with salt.
Mix together the poppy seeds, nutty seeds, and crispy seeds in a small bowl.
Spread the seed mixture evenly over the flatbread, leaving a 1/2-inch border around the edges.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the seeds are lightly toasted and the flatbread is crispy.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
